crossRefs.note: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.
For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and…
since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in…
Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may…
Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they…
except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the…
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.
By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

translations.web: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
translations.bsb: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
translations.kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
translations.asv: even so, being affectionately desirous of you, we were well pleased to impart unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were become very dear to us.
